what: A row of backslashes (\\\\) matching the character count is laid down in steps first, then as that row is cleared from the left, the text is revealed in the same steps. Length is characters × .05s (max .7s), steps are characters × .9, and the text starts later than the mask by length/characters × 2 — to write it each time like a menu drawer, use on: manual with fx:play · fx:rest

options.on: scroll (default — once when visible) · load (as soon as loaded) · manual (only when fx:play is received, hidden again by fx:rest)
options.char: when it goes, the character, default \
options.look: With accent, the mask text uses the accent color
options.--fx-per-char: CSS variable — time per character, default .05s (menu .04s)
options.--fx-steps-factor: CSS variable — number of steps = Character count × this value, default .9 (menu .8)
options.--fx-offset: CSS variable — how far the text lags behind the mask (in characters), default 2 (menu 1)

from.where: shared.css .tb-st (section heading // Work·Partners, Hero scene text, menu drawer items) — original c-scramble-text three layers of clip-path steps()

note: Uses CSS round() for step counts (Chrome 125+). In browsers that can’t read it the transition is dropped and it appears immediately
